title: CryptoTraceTransactionEvidence
description: MongoDB Schema definition for Ingested Blockchain Transaction Records

caseId.description: Foreign key reference to Case caseId

block.description: Block height where transaction was mined

direction.description: Fund flow direction relative to investigated subject

asset.description: Cryptocurrency or token ticker (e.g. ETH, BTC, USDT, USDC)

amountUsd.description: Historical or current fiat valuation in USD

counterparty.description: Sender (if IN) or Receiver (if OUT) wallet address

counterpartyLabel.description: Forensic intelligence label (e.g. Victim Smart Contract, High-Risk Mixer, Exchange Deposit Hot Wallet)

counterpartyType.description: Entity category (e.g. exchange, mixer, victim, intermediary, bridge)

riskFlag.description: Whether transaction triggered an AML or ML risk heuristic rule
